description: Your rank and season metrics in every Open Arena season you have joined, how many more signals you need to be ranked, and the season open for entry now (and whether you are in it). Each season's scoring_basis says how it ranks: closed_only (from December 2026) counts only trades closed during the season, so signals_needed is closed trades still needed and open trades don't count; mark_to_market (November 2026) counted every signal, an open one at its latest price. Before a season opens, upcoming is the next one and when it opens for entries. luck: your luck meter (season and all time), how often random picks on the same days did as well as your closed calls.
name: get_my_arena_status
title: Your Open Arena standing
